item.title: Is Cloudflare reporting abuse system flawed?
item.summary: Disclaimer: NET shareholder since 2019 here. Some days ago a redditor was looking for help after getting his credit card charged on a fraudulent e-commerce website. Fraudulent: hxxps://nestmyhaus[.]com Original: https://www.leroymerlin.it/ I did a whois and found that DNS records are managed by CF. I submitted an abuse report via the form which was rejected 20 minutes later. Emails to abusereply@cloudflare.com have been automatically rejected. Can’t submit a second report with the same hostmane. The malevolent website is still out there probably taking other victims. Honesty this feels exactly the same as reporting posts on social media, A total waste of time. Why does CF even provide that form? Ranting about this here on HN as this has been proven determinant in the past. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49342509 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
